title: Canzoneri 2013 · Experiment 3, pointing control
citation: Canzoneri, E., Ubaldi, S., Rastelli, V., Finisguerra, A., Bassolino, M., & Serino, A. (2013). Tool-use reshapes the boundaries of body and peripersonal space representations. Experimental Brain Research, 228, 25-42.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.training: Point with the arm toward an object beyond reachable space.
published_method.stimulus: 3000 ms pink noise, apparent approach and recession, and forearm tactile stimulation.
published_method.response: Speeded vocal detection. Evaluate the distance-by-phase contrast and compare pre/post sigmoid centers.

stimulus_type.source: Article pp. 27–30, Experiment 1A Methods and Fig. 1A

source_provenance.value: Two physical loudspeakers. Canzoneri et al. 2012 is the named procedure precedent.
source_provenance.source: Article pp. 27–30, Experiment 1A Methods and Fig. 1A
source_provenance.gap: Original stimulus audio and exact rendering implementation unavailable.

trajectory_path.gap: Distances at the five perceived positions and precise speaker coordinates unreported.

renderer_or_apparatus.source: Article pp. 27–30, Experiment 1A Methods and Fig. 1A

condition_intermixing.source: Article pp. 27–30, Experiment 1A Methods and Fig. 1A
condition_intermixing.gap: Exact trial intermix and ordering rule unspecified.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Two 20-minute pointing blocks. Baseline assessment order is counterbalanced. Each pointing block is immediately followed by one assessment, with each task assessed once post-training and the task order counterbalanced.
blocked_or_random_order.source: Article pp. 37–39, Experiment 3 Methods and Fig. 6

iti_jitter_policy.source: Article pp. 27–30, Experiment 1A Methods and Fig. 1A
iti_jitter_policy.gap: An extra between-trial interval, jitter, and randomization rule are unreported. The 1000 ms flanks are within trial.

response_window.source: Article pp. 27–30, Experiment 1A Methods and Fig. 1A
response_window.gap: Instruction to respond immediately. The deadline and voice-key acceptance rule are unspecified.

value.participant: seated blindfolded with right arm prone on side table
value.response: Say TAH as soon as touch is detected and ignore sound. Withhold on sound-only trials.

implementation_gaps: Exact original two-speaker gain functions and the full trial-family allocation are unreported.
Physical tactile site calibration and voice-key latency require a measured response scheduler.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
